Title: Azure Media Services and Video Indexer

Body.Content:
Azure Media Services and Video Indexer make it easy to integrate advanced media processing and AI-based media metadata extraction on your apps and workflows. The new Azure Media Services API surfaces a simplified development model.

Learn More
